rules.name: Core Curriculum
rules.desc:
Students must enroll in CSRE 100 or CHILATST 100 before a declaration is approved for the minor in Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies.
Please note that students are encouraged to begin the declaration process as soon as possible. The minor will be tagged as “pending” until CCSRE confirms enrollment in one of the gateway courses.

rules.name: Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies Electives
rules.desc:
Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies minors must complete the remaining units of their 30-unit minimum with elective coursework in Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies, with the exception below.

Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies minors may count up to 5 units of Department of African and African American Studies (DAAAS), Asian American Studies (ASNAMST), Comparative Studies in Race and Ethnicity (CSRE), Jewish Studies (JEWISHST), and/or Native American Studies (NATIVEAM) courses toward their degree in Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies.

rules.name: Up to 5 units of DAAAS, ASNAMST, CSRE, JEWISHST or NATIVEAM courses

limits.label: DAAAS, ASNAMST, CSRE, JEWISHST or NATIVEAM courses

grading: A minimum grade of C- is required for a student to count a class towards the Core Curriculum, including the Gateway or Minor Core. Additional units toward the minor require a passing grade of D- or above. Student may count 1 class with Satisfactory/No Credit (SNC) grading basis toward Additional Units.
policies: No more than 5 units of petitioned courses that are not listed under CCSRE or cross-listed with CCSRE may be applied to electives in the Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies minor. Students who wish to petition a course must fill out and submit a course petition form for the CCSRE Academic Programs team to review within one month of completing their annual degree audit meeting with the CCSRE Student Services Officer.
transferPolicy: Up to ten units of external credit may be applied toward elective coursework in the minor.
reviewNotes: You need CSRE 100 and CHILATST 100, each letter graded with a C- or better, and the rest of the 30 units in CHILATST electives with a passing grade, of which up to 5 units can be AFRICAAM, ASNAMST, CSRE, JEWISHST or NATIVEAM courses. You check by hand that no more than one elective is S/NC and petitioned courses not listed under CCSRE (at most 5 units).
